_comment: This framework repo's OWN Claude Code settings (it dogfoods the model). Autonomous posture so work here runs unblocked; the SessionStart workflow hook and the default-branch / force-push guard reference the repo-local scripts so they apply even before a global install. A target project gets its own autonomous settings from templates/settings.template.json via /ar-install, and the global hooks from install.sh. NOTE: the deny list is defense-in-depth, not a boundary (a prefix match, so it does not stop bash -c or rephrased commands); do NOT add Bash(bash:*) to allow, since that would let any denied command run via bash -c. The authoritative controls are the PreToolUse guard and server-side branch protection.
